title: Release E (frontend only): emoji 20% larger in posts, replies, DMs and the conversation list (backlog #51)
protocol: Kiro Supervised. Kiro creates the 2 new files and replaces the 3 existing files with the FULL content given in edits[], using the IDE write tool. Read-only git (GIT_PAGER=cat) and the gate commands below only. C runs every mutating git, AWS and docker command. No cwd parameter; every command starts with an absolute cd. Run commands one at a time. Run G6 (eslint) through the background-process tool wrapped in bash -c.
must_not: any AWS CLI, docker, bin/ script, install, npx without --no-install
editing any file not in scope
hand-editing a file to force a gate to pass — report the failure instead

checks.expect: e7148ff (Release D) at HEAD on kiro-dev

checks.cmd: cd ~/aws-bootcamp-cruddur-2023 && ls frontend-react-js/src/lib/; ls frontend-react-js/src/lib/emoji.js frontend-react-js/src/lib/emoji.css; echo exit=$?
checks.expect: Report verbatim. The lib folder exists (DateTimeFormats.js lives there); emoji.js and emoji.css must NOT exist yet (ls errors, exit=2).
exit=1 (class and function names are unused)

stop0.then: Reply 'STOP 0 complete' with each result and wait for GO.

replace the whole file with content (LF, trailing newline exactly as shown)
replace the whole file with content (LF, trailing newline exactly as shown)
create the new file with content (LF, trailing newline exactly as shown)
create the new file with content (LF, trailing newline exactly as shown)

gates.cmd: cd ~/aws-bootcamp-cruddur-2023 && grep -c $'\r' frontend-react-js/src/components/ActivityContent.js frontend-react-js/src/components/MessageItem.js frontend-react-js/src/components/MessageGroupItem.js frontend-react-js/src/lib/emoji.js frontend-react-js/src/lib/emoji.css; echo exit=$?

order may differ; exactly these 6 lines

gates.expect: exit=0, no errors. Pre-existing warnings on untouched lines (e.g. == in MessageGroupItem.js) are allowed — report verbatim.

gates.expect: exit=1 (both new files are pure ASCII)

tested_by_claude: Grapheme grouping run in Node 22 (same Intl.Segmenter as browsers): ZWJ families, skin tones, flags, keycaps stay whole; runs of emoji share one span; plain digits, #, ©, ®, ™ and text-style ❤ stay normal text. Rendered in Chromium at 16px: 1.0 vs 1.2 before/after, and a wrapped paragraph confirms line spacing stays even (line-height: 1).
report: Paste every STOP 0 and gate command with full output.

c_after_kiro.1_commit: git add the 3 modified + 2 new files + _docs/specs/kiro-spec-release-e.json; git commit -m 'Release E: emoji 20% larger in posts, replies and DMs (#51)'; git push origin kiro-dev
c_after_kiro.2_frontend:
./bin/frontend/build, then:
REPO=frontend-react-js; CFG=aws/cfn/frontend/config.toml
NEW=$(aws ecr describe-images --repository-name $REPO --query 'sort_by(imageDetails,&imagePushedAt)[-1].imageDigest' --output text)
aws ecr describe-images --repository-name $REPO --image-ids imageDigest=$NEW --query 'imageDetails[0].[imagePushedAt,imageTags]' --output text
echo "$NEW"; echo -n "${NEW#sha256:}" | wc -c
grep -n EcrImage $CFG
# CHECK: pushed a minute ago, 64 chars, NOT the current digest (d70d67a7…). Then:
sed -i "s|$REPO@sha256:[^']*'|$REPO@$NEW'|" $CFG
grep -n EcrImage $CFG
./bin/cfn/frontend-deploy

verify_after_deploy: Hard refresh. 'Welcome to the new Crudsters…🫠🥳🥸🎈' — emoji visibly a little larger than the text, #Crud unchanged
A multi-line post with an emoji: line spacing even
Messages page: conversation list preview and the open conversation show the larger emoji
Links and hashtags still work; replies (14px) get emoji 20% larger than 14px
rev2_note: Rev 2: emoji.js is now pure ASCII. Rev 1 had literal invisible U+FE0F / U+20E3 characters in the regex and emoji in comments (Kiro flagged it at STOP 0); they are now \uFE0F / \u20E3 escapes and words. Behaviour is identical (re-tested in Node).
